# WeHavePhones 0.0.12

An alpha update fixing a controller regression in 0.0.11.

Install over your existing version to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.**

## Touch controls

- The action wheel is now enabled by default on wide screens. Turn off **Menu → Touch controls → Action wheel** to use standard action bars. Existing saved choices are preserved.

## Fixes

- Moving the left stick on a controller no longer presses the D-pad too, so D-pad bindings in WoW only fire from the D-pad. This fixes a regression in 0.0.11 (#39).

## Validation

- All 14 host suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.
- Forever 1.60.1.70938 passed in the signed 0.0.12 RC on a Galaxy S23+. Controller UI persisted after an in-game exit and relaunch. World entry and jumping passed with default controls.
- Touch controls passed world entry, jumping, stick movement and camera turning. The wheel passed swipes in both directions, hub taps and casting Healing Touch from an existing slot.
- Settings were restored and controller UI returned after the touch tests. No new Android crash entries appeared.
- Other game versions were not rerun at the maintainer's request. Physical controller hardware was not tested.

Touch controls and China region support remain experimental.

## Install and support

Requires a 64-bit ARM phone, Android 8.0+, game storage, and your own Battle.net account and game license. Report bugs through **Diagnostics → Report a problem**.

Unofficial and unaffiliated with Blizzard. Sign in inside Battle.net. WeHavePhones never asks for, stores or types your Battle.net credentials.

An alpha update with redesigned touch controls, lower graphics memory use and controller fixes.

Install over 0.0.10 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Major change to touch controls

The new touch action wheels have four rings of nine slots using WoW's Action Bars 6 to 8. Swipe around the hub or tap it to change rings, tap a slot to use it, and hold a slot to change it.

**Existing touch-control users may need to re-add their spells and items to the new wheels.**

![Redesigned touch controls with the action wheel](https://github.com/ashmerra/wehavephones/releases/download/v0.0.11/WeHavePhones-0.0.11-touch-controls.png)

Separate Forever measurements on a Galaxy S23+ saved about 100 MB and 60 to 85 MB respectively. The previous Turnip driver remains available in the Graphics driver list.
- Added **Save memory with lower graphics** in Settings, off by default. It disables shadows and multithreaded rendering at the next Play. Turning it off restores each game's previous settings. - Fixed the touch action wheel hub ignoring taps on Retail.

releases.body:
An alpha update focused on touch controls, launch reliability and addon apps.

Install over 0.0.9 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Changes

- Touch chat starts compact when you enter the world and expands when you use it. Its controls stay clear of page keys and the keyboard.
- The touch quest tracker sits below the player frame. Play-mode drags turn the character, and the current touch mode is easier to see.
- Fixed taps missing their target when the Android keyboard pans the game screen.
- Fixed an exited WoW process blocking the next launch.
- Disabled Wine audio codec drivers that delayed Battle.net startup. Previous controlled S23 measurements reached the Play button about six seconds sooner.
- Fixed WowUp hanging at its logo with a backport of Wine's large-message fix. Removed the obsolete WowUp app patch.
- Added automated game and addon app checks for contributors.

## Testing and limitations

- All 13 host check suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.
- The standard Dev build passed the native UI check on a Galaxy S23+. The E2E scenarios below ran on that Dev build. The signed release installed over 0.0.9 and launched without clearing app data, with no new Android crash entry. Gameplay was not repeated in the signed package.
- Forever 1.60.1.70862 passed world entry and jumping with default controls. Its touch scenario passed world entry, jumping, stick movement and camera turning.
- WowUp passed startup through its addon-folder scan marker.
- CurseForge timed out waiting for its Mods Agent on the first attempt. A separate retry passed connection, library scanning and the 30-second stability check. Startup can stall and require reopening the app.
- No new Android crash entries were recorded during these E2E scenarios. The runner restored the player's app settings.
- Other WoW versions were excluded from this release validation at the maintaine

releases.name: v0.0.9
releases.body:
An alpha update focused on Forever touch controls, launch frame pacing and diagnostics.

Install over 0.0.8 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install it for you.

## What's new

- Battle.net and the launch screens now run at 30 FPS to reduce rendering work before WoW starts. The cap lifts automatically when WoW starts, so gameplay is unaffected.
- Diagnostics now includes Android's recorded reasons for recent app exits, helping identify low-memory closures and crashes. Available on Android 11 and later.
- Added experimental Turnip Gen8 V38 as a manual graphics driver choice on Adreno 7xx phones.

## Touch control fixes

- Forever now receives the touch layout, with chat, player frames and hotbars positioned clear of the touch buttons.
- Forever's controller and gamepad interface now turn off when launching with touch controls. Turning touch controls off restores your previous controller settings on the next launch.
- Fixed "Interface action failed because of an AddOn" errors caused by the Forever touch layout during combat.
- Fixed Forever's hidden quest tracker and quests disappearing when selecting a target.
- Forever's Social window now fits the screen. Bags leave room for window side tabs, and the Keys bag button no longer overlaps All.
- Retail's smaller chat now also shrinks its side buttons.
- Play touch mode now hides the mouse pointer. Menus and Inspect still show it.
- Changing the touch-control setting during a game now takes effect on the next launch, keeping the controls matched to the running game.

## Other fixes

- The game list now calls the live game **Forever**, replacing **Forever Stress Test**.
- Fixed Qualcomm v891.7 driver downloads failing verification on Adreno 8xx phones.

## Testing and limitations

- The signed 0.0.9 build installed over 0.0.8 on a Galaxy S23+ without clearing app data. Battle.net sign-in, Classic Era world entry, and Forever installation and world entry were verified, with no new Andro

releases.body:
An alpha release with new experimental touch controls, refreshed on-screen controls, SD card installs and keyboard fixes. Expect bugs.

Install over 0.0.7 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install it for you.

## What's new

- **Touch controls (experimental):** You can now play every WoW version without a controller, using only the touchscreen. Turn it on in Settings → Mobile touch controls. Play mode puts a movement stick, camera control and your main actions on screen for moving and fighting. Menus mode turns your finger into a mouse pointer for bags, vendors, the map and other windows, and a switch on the toolbar flips between the two. A touch menu opens every game window, and a short guide explains the controls the first time you use them.
- **New look for the on-screen controls:** The on-screen controls now use WeHavePhones blue, with rounded keys and clearer labels. Buttons and D-pad directions light up while you hold them.
- **More Turnip drivers for Adreno 8xx:** The Graphics driver list offers seven more experimental Turnip drivers. We will keep adding new builds until one works well for WoW, but for now the system driver is still the one to use. Automatic stays on it and the new drivers download only when you pick one.
- **Less memory at startup:** Every game now has player model preloading turned off. Player models load when the game first needs them instead of all at once, which lowers the memory WoW needs to boot. Your other graphics settings stay as they are.

- Battle.net can now install World of Warcraft to an SD card or to the phone's shared storage, through a drive letter set up in the container's drive settings. It used to stop with "We couldn't access a folder. This is usually because you're not logged in as an administrator." (#20)
- Play and Add-ons now find a game that Battle.net installed on another drive, as long as there is no copy on C:.
- Play no longer sits on "Updating World of Warcraft" whe

releases.name: v0.0.7
releases.body:
An alpha release focused on performance, memory, screen fit and controls fixes. Expect bugs.

Install over 0.0.6 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install it for you.

## What's new

- **D3D11 on every phone:** WoW now runs with D3D11 instead of D3D12. It needs less GPU work per frame, so the phone throttles less. In WoW: Forever on a Galaxy S23+ the frame rate in the world went from about 25 fps to the game's 60 fps cap in long sessions. You can still choose D3D12 in the game's graphics options, but the app switches it back to D3D11 at the next launch.
- **Less GPU memory:** The graphics layer now reserves GPU memory in smaller blocks, which left about 180 MB less of it unused in WoW: Forever on a Galaxy S23+. Phones share this memory with apps, so more of it stays available.
- **Resolutions that fit your screen:** "Game resolution" in Settings now also offers sizes with the same shape and aspect ratio as your phone's screen, so WoW fills wide and foldable screens without black bars while using less memory than the native size. On a foldable, the inner and cover screens each keep their own choice (#26, #27).
- **Forever Gamepad UI:** World of Warcraft: Forever now starts with its Gamepad UI (Alpha) turned on, so you no longer need a controller to switch it on in Options. You can still turn it off there and it stays off.

## Fixes

- Fixed the Virtual Gamepad controls, and copies of them, disappearing a moment after you picked them in Input Controls. A profile you pick there now stays for the rest of the session, also on the container desktop, with a controller connected or with "Disable virtual gamepad" on. Diagnostics now list the controls state and every device the app counts as a game controller (#25).
- Fixed a Battle.net process from an earlier session staying in memory. One kept about 400 MB across sessions and app updates. Pressing Play now closes it.
- China region (experimental): Battle.net China sign-in now completes. T

## Def Jam Android v1.4 — The Big Update

### Geração de quadros experimental

- Adicionamos **Lossless / LSFG** e **Win-FG** ao modo Vulkan nativo. O LSFG pode atuar nos menus, nas cenas e nas lutas. O Win-FG fica restrito às lutas.

The first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. **Alpha:** a handful of games run, some at full speed; many are slow or don't boot yet. The app tells you when a new version is out.

**Requirements:** Android 12+ (arm64), a Vulkan 1.3 GPU, 12 GB of RAM recommended, and your own PS5 game dumps. Tested on Adreno 830 (AYN Odin 3). Other Adreno GPUs and Mali: download a Turnip or PanVK driver in *Settings → Graphics → Download drivers*.

**Playable at 60 FPS on the Odin 3:** Dead Cells, Blasphemous, Animal Well, Greak: Memories of Azur, The Binding of Isaac: Repentance, Monster Boy. Full list in the README and on https://capyps5.org.

**Includes no games, BIOS, firmware or Sony keys, and needs none.** Only use games dumped from your own console.

Report problems on Discord (https://discord.com/invite/PEE7Q5TVM5) with the log the app saves when a game closes.

Fifth alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. Mali GPUs on their system driver can now run games, and the FPS counter shows how many frames CapyPS5 Framegen adds. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**New**
- **Mali on the system driver:** that driver cannot sample BCn compressed textures, so the GPU used to be rejected. CapyPS5 now decompresses those textures on the GPU when it uploads them (BC1 to BC7, including BC6H HDR textures). GPUs that support BCn keep using it directly.
- **PanVK on Mali:** the GPU is no longer rejected when the driver lacks vertex-stage stores or dual-source blending.
- **Framegen counter:** with CapyPS5 Framegen on, the FPS counter reads *XX FPS - YY FG*: XX are the game's own frames, YY the total including generated ones. The options are now called *Framegen x2*, *x3* and *x4*.
- **HDR10 output:** games that output HDR10 are converted to SDR for the screen.

**Fixed**
- Tessellation: quad domains, fractional-even spacing, counterclockwise output and masked hull control points.

releases.name: v0.1.2
releases.body:
Fixes the ConsolePort wizard reappearing on every login ([reported on Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/EmulationOnAndroid/)).

If you interacted with the addon's controller-setup wizard during your very first login, WoW saved a half-finished configuration that blocked the automatic setup from ever applying — so the wizard kept coming back. The app now re-checks your account every time you press PLAY and repairs that state automatically (your previous file is kept as `ConsolePort.lua.bak`).

**If you were affected:** update, exit the game completely, press PLAY again. The wizard should be gone and the full pad mapped.

Also clarifies the first-login instructions shown in the app. Non-English clients (frFR, deDE, …) are fully supported — the locale was unrelated to this bug.

releases.name: v0.1.1
releases.body:
First public release.

**WoW Mobile** runs World of Warcraft 3.3.5a (Wrath of the Lich King) on Android with touch controls designed for [ConsolePortLK](https://github.com/leoaviana/ConsolePortLK). It is a single-purpose fork of [Winlator](https://github.com/brunodev85/winlator) (LGPL-2.1).

## Install
1. Download and sideload `wow-mobile-v0.1.1.apk` (installs alongside stock Winlator — separate app id `it.wowmobile`)
2. Put your own WoW 3.3.5a (build 12340) client folder on the phone's storage — **no game files are included**
3. Open the app → allow storage → *Select game folder* → PLAY

On first launch the app installs the bundled ConsolePortLK addons, calibrates the bindings, sets the realmlist (changeable in WoW Settings) and creates a tuned Wine container. After your first login, log out once so it can finish per-account calibration — then everything just works.

## Highlights
- One-tap play: folder validation, addon install, key bindings, realmlist and graphics config are all automatic and idempotent — an already-configured folder is never damaged
- Touch overlay tuned in real gameplay on a Pixel 8: movement pad, UI-navigation pad, face buttons, Shift/Ctrl modifiers, camera toggle, map, jump, target, left/right click
- WoW Settings: realm server switcher, resolution, view distance
- Container Settings: full Winlator container editor with WoW-tuned defaults
- Based on Winlator main with fixes: hardened GPU probing (2 native crash fixes), missing `IntArray_indexOf` from upstream

World of Warcraft is a trademark of Blizzard Entertainment. This project is not affiliated with Blizzard. Bring your own client.

# Swap2-Native 0.1.8.5-beta

A new Graphics setting for how the game's memory reaches the GPU, with a new default.

**Install over 0.1.8.4-beta (or any 0.1.5-beta and later).** Games, packs, mods and saves are kept. Nothing is prepared again.

## New
